files.role: Pure spaced-repetition scheduling logic — independently unit-testable, no DB or HTTP dependency

public_objects.name: VALID_GRADES
public_objects.purpose: frozenset/tuple of the four accepted grade values: again, hard, good, easy

methods.name: compute_next_due_at
methods.purpose: Implements the exact scheduling formula from 10_architecture.json contracts.invariants: again -> now + 5s flat; hard/good/easy -> now + max(floor, 2*elapsed) where elapsed is null-safe against a never-reviewed card, using the fixed floors 1 minute / 20 minutes / 1 day

files.role: One-shot markdown ingestion — CLI entrypoint plus a directly-callable function for tests. Implements the full grammar defined in 10_architecture.json internal_flow steps 2-3: YAML front matter, `## Heading {#anchor}` section splitting, single ```flashcards fenced YAML block per section, transactional upsert keyed by slug / (essay_id, anchor_slug) / (essay_id, card_key).

public_objects.name: IngestionError
public_objects.purpose: Raised for any parse/validation failure before a database write is attempted; carries a human-readable message citing the offending line, section, or card

methods.name: ingest
methods.purpose: Reads and parses the markdown file at path, validates it fully, then performs the transactional upsert against the given connection. Raises IngestionError on any validation failure before touching the database. Callable directly from tests without shelling out.

public_objects.name: IngestSummary
public_objects.purpose: Return value of ingest(): counts of essays/sections/flashcards created vs. updated

private_objects.name: _parse_front_matter
private_objects.purpose: Extract and yaml.safe_load the leading '---' delimited front matter block; requires non-empty title and slug

private_objects.name: _split_sections
private_objects.purpose: Scan body lines for `^##\s+(.+?)\s*\{#([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)\}\s*$`; returns ordered (heading, anchor_slug, content) tuples; raises IngestionError on a `##` line missing the anchor suffix

private_objects.name: _split_body_and_cards
private_objects.purpose: Given one section's raw content, locate at most one ```flashcards fenced block; returns (body_markdown, cards_yaml_text); raises IngestionError on multiple fences or trailing content after the fence

private_objects.name: _parse_cards_yaml
private_objects.purpose: yaml.safe_load the fenced content, validate top-level `cards` list, validate each entry has non-empty id/q/a

private_objects.name: _validate_uniqueness
private_objects.purpose: Raise IngestionError if the same anchor_slug appears twice across sections, or the same card id (card_key) appears twice across the whole file

private_objects.name: _upsert_essay
private_objects.purpose: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE; returns essay id

private_objects.name: _upsert_section
private_objects.purpose: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (essay_id, anchor_slug) DO UPDATE; returns section id

private_objects.name: _upsert_flashcard
private_objects.purpose: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (essay_id, card_key) DO UPDATE ... RETURNING id, created_at, (xmax = 0) AS was_inserted; if was_inserted, also inserts the matching flashcard_review_state row with last_reviewed_at=null, next_due_at=created_at

files.role: GET /flashcards/due and POST /flashcards/{flashcard_id}/review. The review handler takes the raw Starlette `Request` (not a Pydantic body model) and validates the `grade` field manually against backend.scheduling.VALID_GRADES, so a missing grade key, a non-string grade value, an out-of-set grade value, or an unparsable JSON body are all caught by application code and returned as ApiError with error.code=VALIDATION_ERROR (400) — never FastAPI's default RequestValidationError 422 shape, per R-CON-BP-04.

public_objects.name: router
public_objects.purpose: APIRouter(prefix='/flashcards', tags=['flashcards']) — included by main.py under /api/essaycards

private_objects.name: DUE_SCHEMA
private_objects.purpose: ColumnSchema list for the due-flashcards Dataset: id, flashcard_id, question, answer, essay_id, section_id, anchor_slug, next_due_at

private_objects.name: _due_row_to_dict
private_objects.purpose: Convert a joined flashcard+review_state+section row to a JSON-serializable dict, including both 'id' and 'flashcard_id' set to the same value for Dataset row-id compliance

private_objects.name: _parse_review_grade
private_objects.purpose: Given the raw request body (parsed as JSON, or None/invalid on parse failure), returns the validated grade string or raises an ApiError-producing VALIDATION_ERROR response for any invalid shape: unparsable JSON, missing grade key, non-string grade, or a grade outside backend.scheduling.VALID_GRADES

Container image — mirrors StorageTracker Dockerfile: copies 02_Platform/packages to /platform_packages, sets PYTHONPATH, installs pyproject.toml, copies backend/, schema.sql, tests/. CMD uvicorn backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

Docker Compose service definition: container atlas-essaycards, port 127.0.0.1:8024:8000, ATLAS_PG_* env vars, logs volume at ${DATA_ROOT}/essaycards/logs, a read-only content volume at ${DATA_ROOT}/essaycards/content:/app/content:ro for the ingestion CLI to read source markdown files from, atlas-net network. Port 8024 chosen as the next unused application port (8022=StorageTracker, 8023=Calendar).
Local development entrypoint — loads 01_System/secrets.env, forces ATLAS_PG_HOST=127.0.0.1, starts uvicorn on port 8024. Mirrors StorageTracker's run_local.py.
